name: Cosmic Concealed
detailed_description:
Cosmic Concealed: A Galactic Hide & Seek 

Welcome to the wackiest game of hide-and-seek this side of the universe! In Cosmic Concealed, players are launched into space-themed settings, which includes Earth, the Starship, or Space! One team hides in plain sight—disguised as everyday sci-fi props—while the other team hunts them down. The clock is ticking to find them and eliminate them.

Will you blend in as a bottle on the bridge of a spaceship or a suspicious space cactus. Will you suit up and shoot every suspicious object to uncover your hidden aliens?

Features:

  • Hilarious prop transformations: crates, chairs, and more!

  • 3 epic maps: Earth, The Starship or Space

  • Maps include low-gravity as well as normal gravity.

  • Hiders can use voice taunts!

It’s hide-and-seek—but in SPACE. Are you prepared to vanish?

How to Play

In this game, it’s a round-based game; players will be randomly assigned to Hiders or Hunters. The game will conclude by either time running out or the Hunters finding all of the Hiders, and then it will start a new round.

Hunters: The players assigned to Hunters will be released at a delay. They are tasked to find and shoot any objects out of place. If they hit a Hider, the prop will disappear, leaving a cloud of smoke. Shoot all the Hiders to win the round. Happy Hunting!

Hiders: The players assigned to Hiders will have time to hide and transform into a prop. Hide or move around as the prop to keep hidden from the Hunter. Once time runs out, you win the round. Good luck staying hidden!
